themes.title: Far-right leaders rally behind convicted killer as political symbol
themes.blurb: Italy's Lega and Fratelli d'Italia parties are mobilizing around Mario Roggero, a jeweler convicted of killing two robbers, framing him as a victim of judicial overreach. This cross-national pattern mirrors similar cases in the U.S. and Poland, where right-wing figures have championed individuals convicted of violent crimes as symbols of resistance against perceived liberal bias in the justice system.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Salvini and Meloni publicly support Roggero, with Salvini visiting him in prison and advocating for his pardon and potential political candidacy.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump and allies have previously supported individuals convicted of violent crimes, such as Kyle Rittenhouse, framing them as victims of a biased justice system.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS has similarly defended individuals involved in controversial legal cases, emphasizing themes of national sovereignty and resistance to perceived foreign or liberal influence in the judiciary.

themes.title: Right-wing parties push voting age reforms to engage youth
themes.blurb: Hungary's Tisza government and Poland's PiS are both advocating for lowering the voting age to 16, aiming to engage younger voters and counter declining support among older demographics. This theme reflects a broader strategy among right-wing parties to expand their electoral base by appealing to younger generations.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Prime Minister Péter Magyar supports lowering the voting age to 16, citing increased youth political engagement and readiness.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS has discussed electoral reforms, including engaging younger voters, as part of broader efforts to maintain political relevance amid internal divisions.

themes.title: Internal divisions fracture right-wing coalitions
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe and the Americas are experiencing significant internal divisions, with factions breaking away or challenging leadership. This theme, previously observed in Poland, Spain, and Argentina, has now intensified in Poland's PiS and Italy's Lega, reflecting broader instability within right-wing movements.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS faces a potential split as Morawiecki's faction defies Kaczyński's leadership, with 45 MPs signing a letter urging unity.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega experiences internal conflicts over leadership and strategy, with figures like Mattuzzi demanding resignations and criticizing party direction.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox faces defections, with Ortega Smith leaving the party and accusing leadership of betraying its founding values.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders exploit crime and security concerns
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in Italy, Spain, and the U.S. are leveraging crime and security issues to push for stricter policies, often framing these as existential threats to national identity and public safety. This theme continues from previous coverage, with a focus on self-defense laws, immigration control, and public order.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni and Salvini push for expanded self-defense laws and zero-tolerance policies on crime, using cases like Roggero's to justify stricter measures.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox demands increased security measures and stricter immigration controls, often linking crime to immigration and calling for tougher law enforcement.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration emphasizes election security and immigration enforcement, framing these as critical to national safety and sovereignty.

themes.title: Trump’s election fraud claims dominate global right-wing discourse
themes.blurb: Donald Trump's persistent claims of election fraud continue to resonate within right-wing circles globally, influencing discourse and policy in the U.S., UK, and Poland. This theme remains dominant, with Trump's rhetoric shaping election security debates and fueling distrust in electoral systems among right-wing supporters.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump delivers a primetime speech on election security, alleging vulnerabilities and foreign interference, while his administration pressures states to adopt stricter voting laws.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage echoes Trump's rhetoric, demanding immediate elections and questioning the legitimacy of the current government.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS leaders criticize election integrity, aligning with Trump's narrative of potential fraud and foreign interference in democratic processes.
